candidates.reason: Turning the headline into a single line works for a leaderboard and keeps the brand colours and fonts. But the headline and tagline group sits about 35px left of the canvas centre, which looks arbitrary. It is also pushed up against the top edge, with about 10px above it and a much bigger gap below. The large empty side areas leave the banner feeling under-filled.

This is identical to candidate 1. The single-line headline and the tagline under it are readable and on brand. The block is off-centre to the left with no clear reason, it is crammed toward the top edge, and the left and right thirds are empty.

It keeps the original's three-line stack, so it reads like a shrunk copy of the original rather than a layout made for a banner. The headline is only about 18px tall, too small for the main message. The stack fills the full height with almost no top or bottom margin, while the sides are a large empty area.
